description.narrative: Participants will be selected based on the assessment report and in close coordination with local government. The specific needs of the highly vulnerable or socially excluded populations will be assessed through focus group discussion, data of the Initial Rapid Assessment (and detail assessment report will be used, coordination with the local government). Assistance packages will be specifically designed to accommodate the different needs or men, women, girls, and boys. Additionally, both Rural Reconstruction Nepal's(Implementing partner ) links to the target communities, and their expertise in supporting hard to reach areas, will help ensure that particularly vulnerable people of any gender, in addition to people with disabilities will have access to the support. Rural Reconstruction Nepal has demonstrated its capacity to deliver gender and age-sensitive assistance. The total targeted participants is 2000 Households.

The aim is to provide immediate assistance and support to households impacted by the earthquake, addressing their basic needs and helping them cope with the aftermath of the disaster in Jajarkot and West Rukum Districts of Nepal.

The project is funded by German Ambassy to respond to the earthquake affected population on Shelter, food and WASH in Jajarkot and Rukum distcirts, Karnali province. The total participants for the response will be 2000 Households of 5 palikas in Jajarkot and 1 palika(admistrative region) in West Rukum. The project will be implemented by local partner, Rural Reconstruction Nepal (RRN) who has experience of earthquake response in 2015 and recent earthquake. The participants will be selected in close coordination with the local stakeholders to avoid duplication and optimization of the use of local resources.
